model.name: R30.16 merge functional correctness (accept-mutates / one-sided ribbons / Y-align / left-history)
model.description: Make the R30.16 3-pane merge FUNCTIONALLY correct (it shipped visually but the merge did not mutate). Five root-caused bugs: #4 accept/cancel arrows had ZERO effect - the per-strip click listener was attached once inside if(!s) and orphaned by the R30.16 re-render; fix = delegate click from the stable component ROOT once in mountThreePane, drop the per-strip listener. #1+#3 both-sided/ghost ribbons - renderConnectorRibbons drew both bands unconditionally; fix = draw Local->Result iff a.length>0 and Result->Repo iff b.length>0 (origin from a/b), gate the take-arrows the same. #2 off-by-one row/ribbon Y - alignPaneRows mixed 0-indexed block arithmetic with Monaco 1-indexed afterLineNumber (len-0 blocks shift by one); fix = pin anchors + handle len===0, with a MANDATORY lineY(remote,bStart)==lineY(center,span[0]) test. #5 history selector on the RIGHT - move it to the LEFT (old-on-left / new-on-right convention) via populateLeftHistory. Tester gate must assert FUNCTION (click mutates CENTER), not appearance (button renders) - the exact R30.16-gate miss.
model.tronQuote: > Tron 2026-07-14 (diligent review): R30.16 merge visuals shipped but it is FUNCTIONALLY broken - the accept arrows do nothing, ribbons draw from empty sides, rows are off by one, and the history selector is on the wrong side. The gate verified appearance, not function.

model.crossRefNote: Functional-correctness fixes for R30.16. Class RbDiffEditor REUSE 18165081. ONE new Method populateLeftHistory (#5, moves the history selector RIGHT->LEFT = old-on-left convention, refining R30.10's right-side-history; ARCHITECT derive-confirm the populateRightHistory disposition - I minted populateLeftHistory as NEW to avoid breaking R30.10/R30.15 chains on 58c11039). Build-note (impl-edits, markers STAY): #4 mountThreePane c4c84142 (delegated click at ROOT) + renderInterPaneGutters fd99c520 (drop per-strip listener + gate arrows); #1/#3 renderConnectorRibbons 5051b2a4 (origin-gate bands) + renderInterPaneGutters fd99c520; #2 renderConnectorRibbons 5051b2a4 + alignPaneRows 17c71adf (index fix). SUPERSEDE (architect-ruled): populateRightHistory Method 3dd2173b + Impl 58c11039 supersededBy populateLeftHistory (auto history right->left); units STAY (R30.10/R30.15 historical credit, not broken); expert removes right-history code+marker WITH adding populateLeftHistory in one build (no orphan). Tester: retire R30.10 right-history test 16b2721a; R30.17 populateLeftHistory test covers left-history. pickRef unchanged.

acceptanceCriteria.text: #4: accept take-arrows WORK - a single delegated click listener on the stable component ROOT (attached once in mountThreePane) routes [data-cid] clicks to acceptChange(id,side)/dismiss; renderInterPaneGutters drops its per-strip addEventListener (only sets innerHTML). Clicking take-Local/take-Repo MUTATES the CENTER Result text content (not just renders a button).
#1: renderConnectorRibbons draws the Local->Result band ONLY iff c.a.length>0 and the Result->Repository band ONLY iff c.b.length>0 - a one-sided change no longer draws both bands.
#3: no ghost ribbon from an empty side (origin taken from a/b length); the gutter take-arrows are gated the same (take-Local shown iff a.length, take-Repo iff b.length).

#2: alignPaneRows afterLineNumber uses a consistent index base (handles len===0 blocks, spacer BEFORE the gap); anchors pinned to the hunk first-changed line. MANDATORY: post-alignment lineY(edRemote, c.bStart) === lineY(edCenter, c.span[0]) (and Local) - source row and its center landing share Y (+-0).

#5: the .de-history <select> renders on the LEFT pane (s==='local'); populateLeftHistory populates the LEFT with the file's git history (old-on-left), RIGHT = working/current; pane labels read old(left)/new(right); swapSides + acceptChange left/right semantics preserved.

★ Tester DET-3x asserts FUNCTION not appearance (the R30.16 miss): (a) click take-arrow -> CENTER editor value CONTENT changes; (b) click ignore -> that change's arrows/ribbon disappear + CENTER unchanged; (c) one-sided hunk -> ribbon from ONE side only (no ghost); (d) lineY(remote,bStart)===lineY(center,span[0]); (e) history <select> on LEFT.
